shared.name: Fear
shared.text: The model causes fear.

shared.name: Stupidity
shared.text: The model is subject to stupidity.

shared.name: Immune to Psychology
shared.text: The model is immune to psychology and never leaves combat.

shared.name: Immune to Poison
shared.text: Not affected by any poison.

shared.name: No Pain
shared.text: The model treats a stunned result on the Injury chart as knocked down.

shared.name: May Not Run
shared.text: The model may not run, but may charge normally.

shared.name: Large
shared.text: This unit is treated as a Large Target. They may always be shot at with ranged weapons with a +1 modifier to hit.

shared.name: Daemonic Flesh
shared.text: The model has a base armour save of 5+. This save is never modified, but blessed or magic weapons and spells negate it completely. The model's attacks count as magical.

shared.name: Perfect Killer
shared.text: Every attack the model makes, shooting or in close combat, has an extra -1 save modifier.

shared.name: Pawnbroker
shared.text: If the model was not taken out of action in the battle, the warband gains an extra 2D6 gold for each item it sells, up to the item's full value.

shared.name: Hate Orcs and Goblins
shared.text: The model hates Orcs and Goblins.

shared.name: Frenzy
shared.text: The model is subject to frenzy.

shared.name: Hate High Elves
shared.text: The model hates High Elves.

shared.name: Hate Bandits and Outlaws
shared.text: The model hates Bandits and Outlaws.

shared.name: Hate Spellcasters
shared.text: The model hates every model that can cast spells.

shared.name: Crystalline Body
shared.text: The model's Toughness becomes 6 and its Wounds 1. Neither can be changed afterwards by experience or mutation: an advance that would change either is re-rolled until it gives another characteristic.

shared.name: Hulking Brute
shared.text: The model gains +2 Strength and suffers -4 Leadership.

shared.name: Poisonous Bite
shared.text: Unless it already has a bite attack, the model gains an extra attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase: a poisonous bite at Strength 5, or Strength 2 against a target immune to poison. A bite attack it already has becomes poisonous in this way instead.

shared.name: Prehensile Tail
shared.text: Unless it already has a tail attack, the model gains an extra tail attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase. The tail may hold and use any single-handed weapon, or carry and use a shield or buckler. A model with other tail attacks picks one tail at the start of each hand-to-hand combat, and uses none of the others while it uses an equipped prehensile tail. A model that can't use weapons only gains the extra attack (unless it has a tail already), and still can't use weapons.

shared.name: Scaly Skin
shared.text: Scales give the model a 5+ save. Strength modifiers can't take this save beyond 6, but any 'no save' result on the Critical Hit charts negates it. Light armour adds +1 to the save, as do other armours.

shared.name: Wings
shared.text: The model can't fly, but it can glide down from a raised position: from a roof, walkway, cliff or other platform it moves 2" horizontally for each 1" it moves down.

shared.name: Suckers
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Blessings of Onogal
shared.text: The model automatically passes Initiative tests when climbing.

shared.name: Plague Carrier
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Blessings of Onogal
shared.text: The model's Movement and Initiative are reduced by 1. Each time it hits an enemy in hand-to-hand combat, the enemy must roll its Toughness or less on a D6, or suffer -1 Movement and -1 Initiative for the rest of the battle (it recovers after the battle). It may infect each model only once in a battle.

shared.name: Beak
shared.text: Unless it already has a bite attack, the model makes an extra bite attack in each close combat phase, at its own Strength and with no penalty for not using a weapon. The bite always strikes last, whoever charged and whatever weapon is used, even after double-handed weapons.

shared.name: Burning Body
shared.text: The model may carry no weapons or armour unless they are magical or of Gromril or Ithilmar. It suffers none of the usual penalties for fighting with its fists, and always counts as having a lantern. At the end of every turn, roll a D6 for each model in base contact with it: on a 4+ that model is set on fire (Border Town Burning, page 70).

shared.name: Electrical Touch
shared.text: The model may give up one of its close combat attacks to jolt an enemy model instead, resolved at +1 Initiative: an automatic Strength 3 hit that ignores all armour saves, or Strength 5 against an enemy wearing any metal armour. After a jolt it takes D3 turns to build another charge.

shared.name: Eye of Tchar
shared.text: Instead of attacking in close combat, the model may try to transfix a living model in base contact that isn't immune to psychology: the victim must pass a Leadership test or be transfixed. A transfixed model may not attack in close combat and counts as knocked down for being attacked. It must pass a Leadership test at the start of each later combat phase, or stays transfixed.

shared.name: Mer-creature
shared.text: The model is aquatic. It can be submerged in water without harm, treats impassable obstacles such as deep rivers, lakes or open sea as difficult terrain, and ignores the penalties for slow-moving rivers and ponds that count as difficult terrain. On land its Movement is reduced by 1.

shared.name: Telekinesis
shared.text: Only a spell caster may have this. In the shooting phase, instead of casting a spell, the model may lift a loose object within 6" with a successful Leadership test (at -3 if the object is taller than 1") and move it anywhere within 6" of itself. A weapon lifted so can be fired in the shooting phase, or used to attack an enemy model in the hand-to-hand combat phase. Once put down, an object needs another successful test to move it or another; the object must be put down before the model casts a spell. This isn't a spell.

shared.name: Centauroid
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Bounties of Arkhar
shared.text: The model's legs become the four legs and body of a beast the size of a small horse: +2 Movement and +1 Toughness.

shared.name: Iron-hard Skin
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Bounties of Arkhar
shared.text: The model's armour save improves by +1. With no armour, its skin alone gives it a 6+ save.

shared.name: Fangs
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Bounties of Arkhar
shared.text: Unless it already has a bite attack, the model makes an extra bite attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase, at its own Strength and with no penalty for not using a weapon. The bite always strikes last, whoever charged and whatever weapon is used, even after double-handed weapons.

shared.name: Spiked Tail
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Bounties of Arkhar
shared.text: Unless it already has a tail, the model gains an extra tail attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase, at its Strength +1. A model that already has a tail decides at the start of each hand-to-hand combat which tail it uses.

shared.name: Regeneration
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Bounties of Arkhar
shared.text: When the model suffers one or more wounds, it may try to regenerate: on a D6 roll of 4+ it heals back to its full Wounds at once. On a lower roll its regeneration is spent, and it may not try again for the rest of the battle.

shared.name: Spit Acid
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Bounties of Arkhar
shared.text: In the shooting phase the model may spit acid at a target up to 8" away: a Strength 4 shooting attack with no penalty for range or for moving.

shared.name: Alluring
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Graces of Shornaal
shared.text: In the first round of combat, every enemy model that isn't Undead suffers -1 to hit. The model also adds +1 to its roll to find rare items.

shared.name: Metallic Growths
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Graces of Shornaal
shared.text: The model has a special 6+ save against missiles and hand-to-hand combat hits. It can't be combined with other armour, but may be taken whenever the model fails any other saving throw. It is never modified, and may be taken even where no saving throw is normally allowed.

shared.name: Agile
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Graces of Shornaal
shared.text: The model gains +1 to Initiative tests, and may ignore the Initiative test it would normally take for being knocked down or stunned within 1" of the edge of a roof, building or other sheer surface.

shared.name: Vestigial Twin
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Graces of Shornaal
shared.text: Each time the model picks a new skill, its twin learns another: pick two skills from the skill tables open to the model. A wizard may instead randomly generate a new spell in place of its own skill, then pick a skill for the twin. When spotting hidden enemies the model's Initiative is doubled, and it ignores the rules for fighting alone (Leadership & Psychology). Its Movement is reduced by 2".

shared.name: Elastic Limbs
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Graces of Shornaal
shared.text: If the model isn't in base contact with an enemy model at the start of the hand-to-hand combat phase, it may make one hand-to-hand attack against a single visible enemy within 6" of it. That enemy can't fight back.

shared.name: Piercing Tongue
shared.from: Mutiny in Marienburg, Graces of Shornaal
shared.text: In the shooting phase the model may make a tongue attack against any model within 2", at its own Strength and with no penalty for range or for moving. It may attack enemy models engaged in close combat, but can't make the attack while it is engaged in close combat itself.

shared.name: Atrophy
shared.text: Part of the model withers. Roll a D6. 1, the head: it is subject to stupidity. 2-4, an arm: it loses the use of one arm and may use only a single one-handed weapon from now on; with both arms lost it is retired from the warband unless it has a tail or bite attack. 5-6, a leg: its Movement is halved, rounding up; with both legs lost it is retired from the warband.

shared.name: Beweaponed Extremities
shared.text: The model's hands become weapons: roll a D6 for each arm, 1-2 a sword, 3-4 a mace, 5-6 an axe. It may no longer use weapons or equipment that need hands. It gains the usual extra attack for an additional hand weapon, and each follows the rules for a weapon of its type (a sword may parry); with two swords it re-rolls failed parries as with a sword and buckler.

shared.name: Brightly Patterned Skin
shared.text: Bright stripes, spots or other patterns on the model's skin. No effect on play.

shared.name: Enormously Fat
shared.text: The model's Movement is halved, rounding up; it gains +1 Toughness and suffers -1 Initiative.

shared.name: Extremely Thin
shared.text: The model's Toughness is halved, rounding up.

shared.name: Furry
shared.text: Long, dense fur covers the model. No effect on its profile.

shared.name: Horns
shared.text: The model gains an extra gore attack in hand-to-hand combat at its normal Strength, and may no longer wear a helmet.

shared.name: Plague Bearer
shared.text: The model's Movement and Initiative are reduced by 1. Each time it hits an enemy in hand-to-hand combat, the enemy must roll its Toughness or less on a D6, or suffer -1 Movement and -1 Initiative for the rest of the battle (it recovers after the battle). It may infect each model only once in a battle. It also causes fear.
shared.why: Plague Carrier, and it causes fear too.

shared.name: Resilient
shared.text: The model gains +1 Toughness.

shared.name: Stunted
shared.text: The model's Movement and Initiative are reduced by 1.

shared.name: Warts
shared.text: Repellent warts cover the model. Its profile is unaffected.

apart.why: Not stupid while a Skaven Hero is within 6".

apart.name: Stupidity (Clan Moulder Rat Ogre)

apart.name: Stupidity (Cold One Beasthounds)

apart.name: Immune to Psychology (Plague Bearers)

apart.why: Automatically passes every Leadership-based test, rout tests included.

apart.name: Immune to Psychology (Plague Cart)
apart.why: Automatically passes every Leadership-based test, rout tests included.

apart.name: Immune to Psychology (Belandysh)
apart.why: Automatically passes all Leadership tests.

apart.name: Immune to Psychology (Ippan Shu)
apart.why: Automatically passes all Leadership-based tests.

apart.name: Immune to Psychology (Madbrains)
apart.why: He passes any Leadership test he is required to take, and may not be promoted to leader.

apart.name: Immune to Psychology (Nightmare)
apart.why: Never takes Leadership tests, and stands still if left leaderless.

apart.name: Immune to Poison (Plague Bearers)
apart.why: Immune to diseases too: a Disease Dagger's spares only the Undead and the Possessed.

apart.name: Immune to Poison (Nurglings)
apart.why: Immune to diseases too: a Disease Dagger's spares only the Undead and the Possessed.

apart.name: Regeneration (Troll)
apart.why: Ignores each wound on a 4+, never one from fire, and never rolls for injury; the mutation heals once.

apart.name: Regeneration (Black Orcs' Troll)
apart.why: The Trolls' rule, but one taken out of action by fire rolls for injury as a henchman.

apart.name: Regeneration (Belandysh)
apart.why: Ignores each wound on a 4+, never one from fire; the mutation heals once.

apart.name: Scaly Skin (Cold One Beasthounds)
apart.why: A 6+ armour save; the mutation's is 5+, and armour adds to it.

apart.name: Scaly Skin (Kroxigor)
apart.why: A natural 4+ save; the mutation's is 5+.

apart.name: Scaly Skin (Chameleon Skink)
apart.why: The Lizardmen's Scaly Skin, a Skink's 6+; the mutation's is 5+.

apart.name: No Pain (Sigmund)

owners.dramatis_persona: Sigmund Spindle, the Harvester of Flesh

apart.why: Ignores knocked down results too: only losing his last wound takes him out of action.

apart.name: No Pain (Veskit)

owners.dramatis_persona: Veskit, High Executioner of Clan Eshin

apart.why: Ignores knocked down results too: only losing his last wound takes him out of action.

apart.name: Agile (Fighting Ape)
apart.why: The Scale Sheer Surfaces, Acrobat and Dodge skills and a diving charge from up to 10" high; the Grace of Shornaal is +1 to Initiative tests.

apart.name: Mer-creature (Fishmen)
apart.why: No Movement penalty on land; the Favour of Tchar is -1 Movement there.

apart.name: Regeneration (Boglar)
apart.why: Each wound ignored on a 5+, never against fire; the Bounty of Arkhar heals every wound on a 4+, once.

apart.name: Regeneration (Warpstone Troll)
apart.why: Each wound ignored on a 4+, never against fire; the Bounty of Arkhar heals every wound on a 4+, once, and the Trolls never roll for injury.

apart.name: Berserkers (Red Toof Goblin)
apart.why: Frenzy, and immune to animosity in a turn he begins within charge range of an enemy.

apart.name: Kindred Hatred (Strigoi Vampire)
apart.why: Hates vampires of every other bloodline, not High Elves.

apart.name: Hatred
apart.text: The model hates every enemy model.
apart.why: Hates every enemy: an open-ended target no shared row names, kept his own and worded short.
